title: vibe-delivery scope plan
description: Written by the planner (vibe) as .vd-plan.json, validated by check-plan.sh, then reviewed and possibly revised by the plan reviewer. The workflow uses the reviewed plan verbatim. Packages fork from the integration branch, which already holds any inherited commits (a build-on branch merged with the default branch).

re_and_sources.description: Prior-art findings (the repo's reverse-engineering corpus rule, if its profile has one) and authoritative sources (URL + fetch date) the plan relies on.

user_decisions_needed.description: Strategic questions only the owner can answer. Empty if none.

bookkeeping_entry.description: Markdown to add to the repo's plan-of-record file (the profile's bookkeeping.plan_entry_file) before the first implementation commit: unchecked tasks with acceptance criteria.

id.description: Short slug, unique in the plan, e.g. wp1-kv-projector.

kind.description: change: the package writes new work and must end with at least one commit. verify_only: the work is already on the integration branch (inherited commits) or needs no change; the package checks it, may end with zero commits, and is delivered by passing gates (its `tests` run as gates) plus a verification note. Never plan a change package that recreates an inherited commit.

high_risk.description: Set by the plan reviewer for concurrency, security or data-integrity work. A high-risk package is adjudicated by the senior reviewer even when the first reviewer approves.

repo_path.description: Must equal the plan's repo_path. Work for another repository belongs to another scope; check-plan.sh rejects a mismatch.

files.description: Every repo-relative path the package may touch: files, directories (trailing /) or bash globs (* spans /). No absolute paths and no '..' segments. Enforced mechanically: anything else makes the run undelivered.

spec.description: Implementation spec precise enough for a coder with no other context.

tests.description: Exact commands that prove the package, run from the repository root. For verify_only packages they are required and are also run mechanically as gates, so they must exit non-zero when the verification fails.

needs_vm.description: True if any step needs the profile's VM (serialized across all lanes).

depends_on.description: Ids of packages in earlier waves that must be integrated first. If one is not, this package is skipped and reported.

review_notes.description: Filled by the plan reviewer: what changed and why.
